readme.excerpt: ## EspoCRM [![PHPStan level 8](https://img.shields.io/badge/PHPStan-level%208-brightgreen)](#espocrm) [EspoCRM](https://www.espocrm.com) is a free, open-source CRM platform designed to help organizations build and maintain strong customer relationships. It provides a wide range of tools to store, organize, and manage leads, contacts, sales opportunities, marketing campaigns, support cases, and more – all business information in a simple and intuitive interface. ![Screenshot](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d0806394-3691-43a1-83a5-16ad2e7314e2) ### Architecture EspoCRM is a web application with a frontend designed as a single-page application and a REST API backend written in PHP. ### Demo You can try the CRM on an online [demo](https://www.espocrm.com/demo/). ### Requirements * PHP 8.3 - 8.5; * MySQL 8.0 (and later), or MariaDB 10.3 (and later); * PostgreSQL 15 (and later). For more information about server configuration, see [this article](https://docs.espocrm.com/administration/server-configuration/).
